name: Koru Neimoidia
description: Koru Neimoidia was a Purse World located in the Colonies region of the galaxy. After being imprisoned by the Galactic Empire, the former journalist Caern Adan hoped that a new warden would be appointed and release him back into the streets of Koru Neimoidia.
